summary: WI-07a delivers one independently testable behavior: a shared section-71 telemetry collector driven purely from the production Simulation that accumulates every section 71 field (play time, current zone, max depth, deaths, crafted upgrades, resources collected/spent, time since last unlock, oxygen remaining on surfacing, encounter trigger timestamps) plus a per-frame/FPS sampler, exposed so the browser debug panel and a headless scenario export emit the identical shared field schema (the Node schema-parity test is the integrative proof, so the two surfaces and the frame sampler are delivery surfaces of one behavior, not separate ones). Scope is bounded to three concrete changed owners, within the leaf limit: (1) a new collector module under src/sim/ including the frame/FPS sampler, (2) the existing browser debug-panel readout (DebugPanel.tick / the Game DebugPanelHost), and (3) the headless Scenario export reading Scenario.sim; all read production sim state and add no gameplay behavior. Boundaries are explicit and checked: this is the recording half of AC-bal-timing only - it changes no balance numbers and does no tuning, which is deferred to WI-07c as the named final proof owner for the 90-120 min blind / 55-75 min expert proof; no backend analytics (local display/log only, section 71); internal ids only in the readout, no creature names or secret text (sections 33/68). Dependency order is correct: the leaf is the foundation with depends_on [] and inherits ST-06 from its parent; WI-07c and WI-07d both correctly declare depends_on WI-07a to consume its telemetry and frame/FPS data, so the cross-child proof is assigned to explicit dependents rather than left implicit. Acceptance coverage holds: it carries AC-bal-timing verbatim and, with WI-07b (AC-bal-scarcity), WI-07c (AC-bal-timing + AC-bal-flow) and WI-07d (AC-bal-perf), the four leaves' union covers all four ST-07 criteria with a single named final proof owner per criterion. Verification is focused on the one behavior: a Node headless scenario asserts every section 71 key is present and non-null and that deaths/resources/unlock counters move as the scenario acts, a Node schema-parity test asserts the headless export key set equals the browser collector key set, a browser shared-harness check (boot ?debug=1, play a short stretch) asserts the extended readout updates, and the headless suite plus build stay green. The fresh-session handoff is accurate - every named symbol was verified to exist (DebugPanel/DebugPanelHost/tick, Game implements DebugPanelHost, sim.state.timeSec, sim.player.maxDepth/o2/inventory/equipmentIds, sim.activeChunks, the triggers.update() fire path, handleDeath/handleCraft/handleBaseReturn/updateProgression, and Scenario/sim/step/stepFor) - so a new implementer can proceed without reconstructing the project.
